top_categories.workout_context: 78 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
GFNY Toscana's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 78 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Toscana's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
58ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At GFNY Toscana, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Toscana. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for GFNY Toscana. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Toscana, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 78 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.

race_overlay.heat: March in Pistoia, Tuscany, Italy can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before GFNY Toscana and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GFNY Toscana’s 78 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at GFNY Toscana. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Toscana requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 78 miles of mixed terrain in Pistoia, Tuscany, Italy.
